context: Reuse the MethodologyDisclosure wording. Change only the remaining inaccurate sites so they name a geometric mean of per-query medians.
description:
Four of five sites describe the default basis as a 'geometric mean of per-query execution times'. That names a reduction with ONE execution time per query, which is not what happens: it is a geometric mean of per-query MEDIANS. BenchmarkIndex.tsx:1086 is the only accurate one, and MethodologyDisclosure.tsx was corrected in explorer-basis-single-run-pass-surfaces.

Three remain: Compare.tsx:799, Home.tsx:592, PlatformIndex.tsx:797.

Promoted from deferral 722 rather than folded into a sibling item because no single item owns all three files: Home and PlatformIndex fall inside explorer-basis-browse-hardware-engine-facets, while Compare falls inside explorer-basis-compare-multi-run-layout. Splitting one wording fix across two items would leave the corpus of copy inconsistent for however long the second one lagged.

Newly reader-visible: explorer-basis-single-run-pass-surfaces added the per-pass view, which is the first surface anywhere in the explorer that shows a query has several executions. Until then the wording was wrong but unfalsifiable from the UI.

anti_patterns.dont: invent a new reduction name or drop the median
anti_patterns.instead: match MethodologyDisclosure: geometric mean of per-query median execution times
anti_patterns.why: the defect is inconsistent wording, not a new metric

preserves.behavior: Do not change ranking math, basis selection, or measurement-run filtering.
Keep the measurement-runs-only qualifier where it is already present.
MethodologyDisclosure remains the accurate default-basis definition.

verifications.command: rg -n 'geometric mean of per-query execution times' results-explorer/src/pages/Compare.tsx results-explorer/src/pages/Home.tsx results-explorer/src/pages/PlatformIndex.tsx && exit 1 || true
verifications.description: No remaining inaccurate default-basis copy on the three sites
verifications.expected: Those three files no longer use the one-time-per-query wording.

verifications.expected: Affected page tests and typecheck pass.
